info.title: xBNC API
info.description: REST API of the xBNC IRC bouncer. Two ways to authenticate: the panel's session cookie (every state-changing request must then send the CSRF token from `/auth/me` in the `X-CSRF-Token` header), or an API token in `Authorization: Bearer xbnc_...` (no CSRF needed). A `read` token can only use GET; a `write` token can do what its owner can, except account security (password, two-factor, tokens, logout); a `metrics` token can only read `/metrics`. Errors are `{"error": code, "message": text}`.
